title: Whoop hero
description: A full-bleed campaign banner: one tall image (portrait on phones, wide on desktop) with an optional pale badge panel at the top holding a bold, tracked uppercase line and a big thin wordmark. The page below rises over its bottom edge in a white lip with 30px rounded top corners.
notes: the original's banner text is baked into its image; the badge is optional
the lip takes the page background colour, so the next block should sit on bg-background
